name: Multilevel Model HLM3 (3 levels)
when_to_use: Hierarchical data on 3 levels (e.g., repeated measures within students within schools).
r_functions: manual computation of ICC and predictions from a pre-fitted lme() object

expected_input.question: How to decompose variance between and within hierarchical levels?
expected_input.note: Needs adaptation before running (see the notes field).

plain_explanation.purpose: Same as the two-level one, but with three layers of groups nested within each other.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are three levels: for example student, school and municipality.
plain_explanation.data_needed: One row per item, columns identifying the two groups above and factors for the three levels.
plain_explanation.example: Explain student scores considering school and municipality at the same time.
